narratives.Description: bug(class-checks): test-under-source-root rejects co-located tests with no waiver; pre-PR cannot pass
narratives.Overview:
1. Co-located name. `packages/core/src/test-boundary/evaluate.ts` exports one predicate, true when the basename ends in `.test.<ext>` or `.spec.<ext>` with `<ext>` one of `ts`, `tsx`, `js`, `jsx`, `mjs`, `cjs`, `mts`, `cts` (case-insensitive), or ends in `_test.go`.
2. Class 1. In `class-checks/evaluate.ts`, a changed path for which that predicate is true is never a `test-under-source-root` finding, by name or by content. `isExempt` and the test roots are unchanged, so the path still goes through class 2 (skipped there as a test file, below), class 3 and class 4 as today.
3. Class 2 test-file skip. Class 2's skip for test-named files also uses that predicate, so a co-located `.test.mjs` is not scanned as production.
4. Class 2 import rule. In a file that class 2 scans (non-test, under a source root or deploy-shaped), an added line whose module specifier in `import … from`, `export … from`, bare `import`, `import(` or `require(` has a last path segment matching `<name>.test` or `<name>.spec`, optionally followed by one of the item 1 extensions, is a `production-references-test-root` finding naming the specifier and line. Added lines only (#7077); no module resolution.
5. Class 1 remediation. The class 1 finding's remediation says: move the path under a test root, or declare it in the merge-base test-boundary policy (`.deft/test-boundary.policy.json` when that file exists on the merge base, else `plan.policy.testBoundary` in `xbrief/PROJECT-DEFINITION.xbrief.json`), preferably as a narrow `allow` entry with a reason; an authored `testRoots` list replaces every default root and must repeat the ones still needed; the policy is read from the merge base, so the policy change lands in an earlier PR. Classes 2 to 4 keep "move or remove". `check/named-cause.ts` 89 is reworded so it reads correctly for every class.
6. Docs. `content/docs/test-boundary.md` states the class 1 co-located exception, the class 2 import rule, and that `verify:test-boundary` still reports co-located tests under source roots (warn by default).
7. One PR. Files: `packages/core/src/class-checks/evaluate.ts` and its test, `packages/core/src/test-boundary/evaluate.ts` and its test, `packages/core/src/check/named-cause.ts`, `content/docs/test-boundary.md`, one `changelog.d/` fragment. No new `.test.mjs` or other non-`.ts` test file under `packages/core/src`. No change to shared default lists, no new verb, flag, policy field or gate step.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Given default policy, when the change adds `src/ui/A.plan-wide.test.tsx` and edits `src/ui/B.test.ts`, each with describe/it/expect content, then `verify:class-checks` reports no class 1 finding.
- Given default policy, when the change adds `src/shared/c.test.mjs` with suite content that names `tests/fixtures/x.json`, then there is no class 1 or class 2 finding.
- Given default policy, when the change adds `src/helpers/smoke.ts` with describe/it/expect content, then class 1 reports `test-under-source-root` with the item 5 remediation.
- Given default policy, when the change adds `src/test_helpers.py` or `infra/scripts/test_release.py`, then class 1 still reports it.
- Given default policy, when the change adds `infra/smoke/prod-health.spec.ts` that binds a test-marker identity, then class 1 does not report it and class 3 does.
- Given default policy, when `src/payments/index.ts` gains `import { Fake } from "./fakeGateway.test"` (or `require("./x.spec.js")`, or `import("./y.test.mjs")`), then class 2 reports `production-references-test-root` naming the specifier and line; an unchanged existing import line is not reported.
- Given a merge-base `.deft/test-boundary.policy.json`, when class 1 fires, then the remediation names that file, not `plan.policy.testBoundary`.
- Given Directive's own `packages/core/src/x/y.test.ts`, then results are unchanged.
- Given the scope fence and write fence on default policy, then `src/ui/A.test.tsx` still classes as a production path (no change to `classifyExtraPath`).

## In plain English
`verify:class-checks` runs inside the pre-PR controller and in the merge gate. Its class 1 fails closed when a test file sits under a production root. A consumer repo keeps its Vitest files next to the source (`src/ui/*.test.tsx`, `src/shared/*.test.mjs`). Every change that adds or edits one of those tests fails class 1, so the agent cannot finish pre-PR and must not push. The failure text says class checks have "no approve, skip, or phrase", so the operator waived the check outside the tool.

Directive already calls this layout normal for itself: its default test roots include `packages/*/src/**/*.test.*` and `packages/*/src/**/*.spec.*` with the comment "Language-idiomatic colocated tests (not production pollution)", and `CONTRIBUTING.md` asks for a colocated test for every new source file. The same layout under `src/**` in a consumer repo is a class 1 failure. A merge-base `plan.policy.testBoundary` (`testRoots` or `allow`) would clear it today, but the failure text does not say so, and a same-PR policy edit that clears a class 1 hit is itself refused.

The recommended fix: co-located JS/TS/Go test files count as test paths by default anywhere, not only under `packages/*/src`; `.mjs`/`.cjs`/`.mts`/`.cts` test names are recognised; class 1 still fails closed on test-only code whose file name does not say it is a test; and the class 1 failure names the merge-base policy route. One PR, no new verb, flag or policy field.

## Operator direction (Scott, relayed by the coordinator; recorded as constraints)
- Prefer fewer gates: recognise co-located tests correctly rather than add a waiver step.

## Pains
- P1 — A repo that keeps JS/TS tests next to its source under `src/` cannot pass pre-PR for any change that adds or edits a test: class 1 fails closed on `*.test.*` / `*.spec.*` under `src/**`, while Directive treats the same layout under its own `packages/*/src/**` as a test root (#6668).
- P2 — The class 1 failure says there is no approve, skip or phrase and names only move or remove, so the operator does not learn that a merge-base `plan.policy.testBoundary` (`testRoots` or `allow`) declares a project layout, and falls back to a waiver outside the tool (#6668).

## Out of scope (named, not pains)
- Class 2 added-line scanning (#7077, merged, not yet released) is unchanged; this arc only changes which paths are test paths.
- Classes 3 and 4 (test identity in infra, protected globs) keep their rules.
- Hook refusal or deny text, install, upgrade, doctor and setup (owned elsewhere); nothing here touches them.
- Detecting a production file that imports a co-located test file (a new class 2 rule); named as a question below, not proposed.

## Evidence
- #6668 (consumer repo, runtime 0.129.13): adds `src/ui/InterviewAgent.plan-wide.test.tsx` and edits `src/ui/LaunchSessionPanel.test.ts`; `deft verify:class-checks` reports `test-under-source-root` "test-only artifact under a non-test root (class 1)", remediation "Move or remove the path. Class checks have no approve, skip, or phrase."; the pre-PR run cannot pass `lint_iteration`.

## Problem

`verify:class-checks` (run by the pre-PR controller's `lint_iteration` gate step) rejects every new or edited test file under `src/` as `test-under-source-root` (class 1). It has no approve, skip, or phrase. Repos that keep tests next to their source cannot pass pre-PR for any change that adds or edits a test.

## Repro

- Consumer: deftai/deftvisage (runtime pin `@deftai/directive-runtime` 0.129.13, launcher 0.129.14). 506 Vitest files live beside their source under `src/` (`src/ui/*.test.tsx`, `src/shared/*.test.mjs`); `tests/` holds only fixtures.
- Branch adds `src/ui/InterviewAgent.plan-wide.test.tsx` and edits `src/ui/LaunchSessionPanel.test.ts`.
- `deft verify:class-checks` →

```
src/ui/InterviewAgent.plan-wide.test.tsx
  kind: test-under-source-root
  detail: test-only artifact under a non-test root (class 1)
  remediation: Move or remove the path. Class checks have no approve, skip, or phrase.
```

The pre-PR run (`ppr_65e6a8daf4732085`) cannot pass `lint_iteration`, so the agent cannot complete pre-PR and must not push (AGENTS.md four-focus rule).

## Expected

Co-located tests are a supported layout (Vitest/Jest default). The class check should honour the project's test roots (e.g. treat `**/*.test.*` / `**/*.spec.*` as test artifacts wherever they live, or read `testRoots` / the test runner config), or offer a project-level policy to declare co-located tests.

## Workaround in use

Operator waived this check for co-located tests in deftai/deftvisage and recorded a decision; all other pre-PR steps still run.

class 1 never reports test-under-source-root for a path that predicate matches; isExempt and the test roots are unchanged, so classes 2 to 4 still see the path

class 2 skips predicate-matching files as tests and reports production-references-test-root for an added production line that imports a .test/.spec module (import, export from, bare import, import(), require())

class 1 remediation names the merge-base policy route (.deft/test-boundary.policy.json, else plan.policy.testBoundary), prefers a narrow allow entry, and warns that an authored testRoots list replaces every default
check/named-cause.ts verify:class-checks line reads correctly for every class
content/docs/test-boundary.md states the class 1 exception, the class 2 import rule and that verify:test-boundary still reports co-located tests
